diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_launch_template.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_fargate_profile.fargate: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.fargate is redundant — already implied by attribute references
aws_autoscaling_group.ng already depends on aws_launch_template.ng through its launch template ID and version references; the explicit dependency duplicates that ordering.

aws_autoscaling_group.ng already depends transitively on aws_iam_role.ng through aws_launch_template.ng and aws_iam_instance_profile.ng (and through the required policy attachments). The explicit role dependency is redundant.
aws_eks_node_group.ng references aws_iam_role.ng in node_role_arn, so its explicit dependency on that role is redundant.
aws_eks_fargate_profile.fargate references aws_iam_role.fargate in pod_execution_role_arn, so its explicit dependency on that role is redundant.
time_sleep.wait already depends on aws_eks_cluster.cp transitively through both aws_autoscaling_group.ng and aws_eks_node_group.ng. Its separate explicit cluster dependency duplicates that ordering.
